<thought>All spectral data point to a monosubstituted benzene bearing a carboxylic acid: 5 aromatic protons, a carbonyl carbon at ~168 ppm, a strong C=O IR band at 1737 cm⁻¹, and O–H stretches around 3500 cm⁻¹. The corresponding SMILES is “OC(=O)c1ccccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>OC(=O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
